news.title: Undergraduate ceremony marks next step for future educators
news.summary_en: IU School of Education students celebrated a special milestone last week when they received their official name badges during the Undergraduate Induction Ceremony. These badges will be used when they work in schools this year as part of their student teaching or practicum requirements.

news.title: Singapore visit opens new opportunities for IU School of Education
news.summary_en: Over the summer, Dean Robert Berry and Professor Faridah Pawan visited Singapore, where they observed how mathematics is taught and built relationships with people in the special education community. The visit connects to a larger effort for teachers at the Association for People with Special Needs to expand their ability to work with people who have autism.
